title: Interpretable stacking model predicts demoralization syndrome in hemodialysis patients
summary: A 12-predictor Stacking-Ridge model was developed in a prospective cohort of 592 maintenance hemodialysis patients and had AUC 0.922 (95% CI 0.883-0.955) in external validation (n = 245), with recall 0.652 and precision 0.714. SHAP highlighted urinary microalbumin, PHQ-9 and HALP score. Follow-up was 5 months and recall is modest.
ai_technology: Stacking ensemble with Bayesian-optimized base learners and SHAP interpretation
organization: Wuhan University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: External validation, decision curve analysis and ablation analyses.
evidence.unknown: Prospective use and impact on interventions are untested. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A stacking ensemble selected 12 predictors from 87 and predicted incident demoralization.
